display_name: 同接收机与留出接收机的配额匹配 IQ 先验对照
description: 只用原 L_s/U_s 各拟合 12600 条同接收机和其他接收机的均值协方差。固定源 V480 七景、已知和盲估信道。

data.version: Original392005 source contract; existing R07 fixed1800 V/7 frozen validation views
data.representation: Original R07 clean L_s6300/U_s56700 and frozen V480×7 original received/Action/noise. For each RX: same RX12600 vs other RX12600, exactly original 10/90 source role balance.
data.tx_sets_ref: Original six known sourceTX; V trueTX validation only, no train/selection
data.actual_training_labels: Statistical fitting on L_s/U_s IQ only. Source V has no fit or model update.
data.augmentation: Reuse all seven original source V observations, no regenerated signals.

permissions.query_use: Source RX metadata chooses diagnostic prior. No target, OE or novel input, no source V fitting.
permissions.claim_scope: Matched-size receiver prior sensitivity under fixed source physical inputs. Known receiver/Action arms are diagnostic.

checkpoint.initialization: Original BF frozen estimator and original Tri-SIG-TIME SSL default head. Statistical priors fit afresh on legal L/U.
sources: FITTING_IQ_ONLY original R07 train63000 source roles and RX/day
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Original validated R07 physical source and frozen V binding. Original same clean and original full-source controls.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen same-source BF and F0. No G training, target or OE/novel/TX access.
checkpoint.selection_rule: All five source RX, fixed V480×7, full/same/other prior in blind and true simulator condition. No prior selection.

metric_names: Same-record TX accuracy, repairs/damage, original clean-correct retention and RX/day groups.
Paired IQ NMSE for full-source, same-source-RX and other-source-RX prior under identical Action and noise.
All source fit quotas. Known-source-RX choice is diagnostic, no Main limit.
dimensions: three prior sets × two Action conditions

rows.purpose: Distinguish source IQ prior shrinkage under same versus excluded source receiver, holding sample counts fixed.
rows.seed_notes: Fixed original record order and original F0; no new RNG or phase selection.
rows.scenario: Original source V480 x7, five inference-only readouts.

notes: Other prior samples105L+945U per each other RX/day; 4RX×3days×1050=12600. Same RX uses all its 12600 original records.
Same and other have equal source counts. Original full-source prior uses63000 and is a separate larger-count baseline.
All comparisons use fixed same cached received IQ and estimator or known Action/noise. No F0 training or replacement head.
